title: Check Robotics SystemDatabaseModel State in SSMS
summary: Use the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) surface to perform a read-only inspection of Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics.dbo.SystemDatabaseModel. Verify the live system configuration state, current SortGuid, EntityInserted timestamp, and EntityLastUpdate timestamp.
when_to_use: Use this WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) diagnostic when support needs to verify the live system configuration state, current sort GUID, and update timestamps in Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics.dbo.SystemDatabaseModel.
not_for: Do not use this read-only diagnostic to modify the database or configuration.
Do not use this procedure as corrective action for a startup, shutdown, staging, requested, or close-out state; the source does not define corrective actions for those states.
